project_type: React 18 SPA with Capacitor for Android, Firebase as primary backend
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify compilation. 2. Run npm run test to verify tests pass.
environment_constraints: Open internet - npm installs work. No Firebase/Android emulator available.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard commit messages.
key_patterns: - Firebase auth via src/lib/firebase.ts (hardcoded config currently). - AuthProvider wraps Firebase onAuthStateChanged, exposes user with uid/id fields. - Supabase client at src/integrations/supabase/client.ts already uses VITE_ env vars. - CallProvider uses supabase for signaling (calls, call_signals tables) - this is broken because auth is Firebase. - App.tsx has ~268 lazy imports pointing to NotFound for planned features. - AppShell.tsx has placeholder unread counts (always 0). - NativeInit component in App.tsx runs hooks for back button and status bar.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - 80+ page components. src/components/ - UI components organized by feature. src/contexts/ - AuthProvider, ThemeProvider, CallProvider. src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/lib/ - utilities (firebase, webrtc, capacitor). src/integrations/ - supabase client. android/ - Capacitor Android project.
